configurePresets.name: clang-base
configurePresets.description: Common settings: Ninja, Clang, one build tree per preset.

configurePresets.name: homebrew-llvm
configurePresets.description: Put Homebrew's LLVM ahead of the Apple toolchain on PATH. Apple Clang has C++20 modules disabled and ships no clang-scan-deps, so CMake cannot resolve the import graph of the core target with it. The formula is keg-only, hence the explicit prefix; adjust it to /usr/local on Intel Macs.

configurePresets.name: clang-debug
configurePresets.description: Configure a Debug build with Ninja and Clang from PATH. Needs a Clang that supports C++20 modules and a clang-scan-deps alongside it.

configurePresets.name: clang-release
configurePresets.description: Configure a Release build with Ninja and Clang from PATH. Needs a Clang that supports C++20 modules and a clang-scan-deps alongside it.

configurePresets.name: macos-clang-debug
configurePresets.description: Configure a Debug build against Homebrew LLVM. The main target is Windows-only and will not build here; build core, test_main and tracy_client instead.

configurePresets.name: macos-clang-release
configurePresets.description: Configure a Release build against Homebrew LLVM. The main target is Windows-only and will not build here; build core, test_main and tracy_client instead.
